# Bootstrap CSS 5.3.3

The admin shell already used this exact Bootstrap version. Its unmodified
stylesheet is now served locally to keep the existing layout usable when the
external CDN is unavailable. This is not a framework upgrade.

- Source: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap@5.3.3/dist/css/bootstrap.min.css
- Upstream: https://github.com/twbs/bootstrap/tree/v5.3.3
- License: MIT; see `LICENSE`.
- SHA-256: `3c8f27e6009ccfd710a905e6dcf12d0ee3c6f2ac7da05b0572d3e0d12e736fc8`.

Bootstrap JavaScript is unchanged by this delivery.
